channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Fort Pierce high-rise development draws packed house at planning meeting as neighbors raise concerns
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board on Monday reviewed the Causeway Cove development project, a proposal that would bring five high-rise buildings to the area off Seaway Drive. item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council set for final vote on Tradition commercial rezoning
item.description: A proposed land use change in Tradition is heading back before Port St. Lucie City Council Monday for a second reading and final vote as one family continues to voice concerns about future development impact.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap with nine road widening projects unfunded
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall as the county estimates it will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote on Tradition commercial rezoning near Crosstown Parkway
item.description: A Port St. Lucie family continues to voice concerns about a proposed land use change in Tradition that would convert nearly 9.5 acres from residential to commercial designation near their home.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall through 2050
item.description: Martin County needs approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving nine road widening projects unfunded.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins first Grand Slam title at Wimbledon after recovering from blown match points
item.description: Czech tennis player Linda Noskova recovered from wasting five match points in the second set to defeat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech Wimbledon final Saturday.

item.title: Rising homeowners insurance costs driving Florida voters to 2026 midterm polls, study finds
item.description: A new study from online insurance marketplace Insurify found that 65% of Florida respondents said rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
